title: Feasibility of a Psychocorporal Relaxation Program in Older Adults With Neurodegenerative Diseases and Behavioral Symptoms (REMEND-CO)
official: Relaxation and Behavioral Disorders in Older Adults With Neurodegenerative Diseases: A Non-Pharmacological Clinical Approach - A Pilot Feasibility Study in a Cognitive Behavioral Unit
summary:
REMEND-CO is a prospective, single-center, single-arm, open-label pilot feasibility study designed to assess the implementation of a structured psychocorporal relaxation program in older adults with Alzheimer's disease or related neurodegenerative disorders and clinically observed agitation, hospitalized in a Cognitive Behavioral Unit.

The study aims to enroll 30 participants aged 65 years or older. In addition to usual care, participants will be offered eight individual relaxation sessions, delivered approximately once weekly over eight weeks by a trained psychomotor therapist.

The primary objective is to assess the feasibility of implementing the program in routine clinical practice. Feasibility will be evaluated through recruitment, session attendance and completion, treatment discontinuations, tolerability, adverse events, and adaptations required during implementation.

Secondary objectives include describing organizational constraints and exploring changes in agitation, neuropsychiatric symptoms, sleep disturbances, and psychotropic medication prescriptions. Clinical assessments will include the Cohen-Mansfield Agitation Inventory (CMAI), Neuropsychiatric Inventory-Nursing Home Version (NPI-ES), and Sleep Disorders Scale for Dementia (SDSD).

A qualitative component involving semi-structured interviews with participants and, where appropriate, their relatives will explore the experience and acceptability of the program.

All analyses will be primarily descriptive and exploratory. As this study has no control group, it is not designed to establish clinical efficacy or a causal effect of the intervention.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 65 years.
* Diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease or a related neurodegenerative disorder.
* Presence of behavioral and psychological symptoms with clinically observed agitation.
* Hospitalization in a Cognitive Behavioral Unit.
* Patients with or without legal protection measures, including patients unable to provide consent personally, in accordance with the applicable consent procedures.
* Informed consent obtained from the patient and/or the legal representative, designated trusted person, or relative, as applicable.
* Affiliation with a social security scheme.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Acute, unstable psychiatric disorder.
* Atypical neurological disorder excluded by the protocol (e.g., progressive supranuclear palsy).
* Opposition to participation.
* Inability to obtain the required informed consent.
* Concurrent participation in another interventional clinical research study involving human participants. The exclusion period corresponds to the duration of participation in REMEND-CO. No additional exclusion period is required after completion of participation.
